changelog:
v2.5.2 — Live TV Audio Fix

• Fixed live TV streams with 2-channel AC3 audio crashing
• Added stereo/mono passthrough matrices for ChannelMixingAudioProcessor
• Switched to EXTENSION_RENDERER_MODE_ON (hardware first, FFmpeg fallback)
• Hardware handles AAC/MP3, FFmpeg handles AC3/DTS/EAC3
